Anduril Industries / U.S. Navy (Arsenal-2, Sparrows Point)

The Navy awarded Anduril a contract worth up to $2.9 billion for Virginia-class submarine components, with payments tied to production outcomes, and Anduril committed $3.7 billion of its own capital to build the 2M-sq-ft Arsenal-2 shipyard at Tradepoint Atlantic, Baltimore County, announced Oct 6, 2026. Combined program $6.6 billion; hiring starts 2029, operations 2030 (single wire story plus trade press). Added 2026-10-12.

The Army awarded Anduril a contract worth up to $1.8 billion over five years to expand the Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) ecosystem to additional units, starting with I Corps; the base period is $162.8 million (DefenseScoop, Oct 6, 2026). Added 2026-10-12.
